who.value: seller promoting several listings, likely regular or Pro

job.value: set up a Spotlight campaign for selected listings and run it

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Spotlight (3 listings)' with 'Listings (3 selected)', 'Priority', 'Weekly budget', 'Duration' and a 'Summary' makes the setup job clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Run Spotlight' button in the Summary is the strongest action.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Run Spotlight' and 'More listings' are clear, but 'Details' doesn't say what it reveals.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Priority' ('Mix of standard and premium', Min–Max) has an info icon, but 'Cost per click Max 140' and 'CoinsBack' are left unexplained.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: A six-step Priority slider and a 2,000–60,000 coin budget slider ask for calls a seller can't size without knowing what each step buys; only 'User clicks 86 to 24…' hints at it.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Summary breakdown sits behind 'Details' and listing selection behind 'More listings'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is about configuring this campaign.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: On top of the controls there is the 'Spotlight more listings to reach 1,200+ buyers' line, a CarouBiz CoinsBack paragraph and a coach-mark bubble to get through.
